preconditions.description: The number of favourite integers t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= 10**18 for x_i in x_list)
preconditions.description: Each favourite integer x_i is between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per favourite integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'YES') == (x_list[i] >= 1 and (x_list[i] - 1) % 5 == 0) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each x_i, output 'YES' if and only if x_i is at least 1 and (x_i - 1) is divisible by 5. This captures all possible visible pip counts achievable by stacking dice.
